userStories.title: Agent loop: runAgent core engine
userStories.description: As a library consumer, I need runAgent(topic, config, options?) to orchestrate the full agent loop and return a validated ResearchResult.
acceptanceCriteria: src/agent.ts exports runAgent(topic, config, options?): Promise<ResearchResult>
Options type: { middlewares?: Middleware[], tools?: ToolDefinition[], onChunk?: (chunk: string) => void, promptFn?: (q: string) => Promise<string> }
Loop: run beforeLLM middleware → build API request → stream LLM via streamChat → detect tool calls → execute local tools via executeTool → append tool results → run afterLLM → repeat
Server tools (from getServerToolNames()) sent in API request tools array for backend execution
Local tools dispatched client-side when tool_calls detected in response
Final text response parsed with ResearchResult.parse() — throws ZodError if invalid
Respects config.maxIterations — throws descriptive error if exceeded
Calls onChunk callback for each streaming messages event
Thread ID from metadata event preserved in state across turns
Tests with mocked streamChat: single turn (no tools), multi-turn (tool call + result + final), max iterations exceeded, invalid structured output throws ZodError, middleware hooks invoked
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
